title: Cross-person motor imagery
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: EEGMMIDB, 225 training trials from five people and 135 test trials from three other people; 64 channels × 480 samples, binary imagery, balanced accuracy. Custom small-person slice; not a standard full MOABB evaluation.

problems: A poor small-sample cross-person reference is not the best MI decoder.
Alignment amendment and reference search effort differ from initial first-program generation.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

recommended_next_comparator: Prospectively freeze a small train-person-selected filter-bank CSP/Riemannian panel; add CBraMod and REVE as separate pretrained references after corpus-overlap checks.
switching_assessment: ADD, do not replace historical scores. Priority high. Tier B supports stronger references, not a current best claim. Keep pretrained and same-data conventional tracks separate; full fine-tuning probably needs a separately declared GPU/runtime budget.
limitations: Only five training and three test people.
Public EEGMMIDB can overlap supervised or self-supervised pretraining.
EEG-Arena dynamic table was not extractable; no stable leaderboard rank asserted.
No new contender has been run on these exact frozen trials.
